note: Fork B, DWARF+KNIGHT look. Two Tripo-studio sculpts, SKINNED and posed per frame (no rigid part split — armour has no cloth give to hide a seam). Same azimuth grid, pose maths, mask/overlay/anchor machinery and FRUSTUM as the minifig sheets, so px-per-unit and footPx are identical and the renderer needs no per-look arithmetic.

bake.azimuthOrder: index a = round(wrap(facingYaw - cameraYawLive + cameraYaw) / (2PI/A)) mod A; a=0 faces the camera

dwarfknight.rigging: skeleton transfer (tools/_fs_dk_rig.py) — the dwarf's Tripo v1.0-20240301 41-joint biped, piecewise-height-fitted to the knight's measured landmarks, Blender automatic weights

tintFormula: rgb = base.rgb * mix(vec3(1.0), tint, mask) + tintEmissive * mask;  alpha = base.a
